name: The watcher in Duskwood

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Elling routes the investigation to Watcher Backus and Defias activity.
description: Elling Trias accepts the courier’s message and sends the search toward Watcher Backus in Duskwood. The instruction concerns recent Defias activity, but it does not yet prove why the brotherhood has entered the inquiry. Each handoff narrows the field while leaving motive uncertain. From Stormwind’s pale walls, the road now leads into a wooded country where old farmsteads and fog keep their own counsel.
